summary: Batch: quick scripts, quick-command bar in terminal, automation (ping/backup/alerts) settings, alerts (webhook + invalid telegram token), config backups (run/diff/summary/delete), device backup fields, deploy httpx bug. Backend: 19/19 passing pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_new_batch.py, including a real fresh-venv install of requirements.txt + `import server` to prove the httpx deploy bug is fixed. Frontend: all requested UI flows verified end-to-end: Batch page (new script + edit + quick + cancel), Terminal at /terminal/dev-2-hops connected and quick-cmd for TEST_QUICK_UI produced 'QUICK-OK' in xterm (bar clickable, not covered), Backups page (list, versions, diff with +/- lines, view dialog + download, run device backup adds a version, run-all toast), Automation page (all cards/inputs, save->reload persists ping_interval=7, restored to 5, ping-now toast, test-alert with no channels shows 'Nenhum canal configurado'), Devices edit dialog shows backup_enabled + backup_command prefilled for dev-2-hops. Cleaned all TEST_ data. Left automation settings clean (no token, notify_devices false, ping_interval 5, backup_hour 3).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has no GET /api/devices/{id}; UI + tests must fetch the list. Consider adding it for symmetry.
PUT /api/devices/{id} rejects partial payloads (422 when host missing) because it re-uses DeviceCreate. Documented behavior; acceptable but easy to trip in a partial-update client.

Scheduler.tick runs every 30 s and reads ping_interval_min; that is fine, but the class-level `last_ping` is only updated when a ping actually runs — GET /automation/settings therefore never reports last_ping from persistence after a backend restart. Consider persisting last_ping in the config collection so it survives restarts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Batch, Terminal quick bar, Backups, Automation, Devices dialog)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_new_batch.py` (19 tests) + `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bastion_features.py` (previous suite). Lab sshd at 127.0.0.1:2222 was NOT running when this run started — I restarted it with `mkdir -p /run/sshd && /usr/sbin/sshd -f /app/sshd_test/sshd_config`. It seems to die between sessions; always verify with `ss -ltn | grep 2222` first. The fresh-venv install test takes ~60 s (installs the full requirements.txt into a temp venv under /tmp).
